assumptions.statement: Official precise redline boundary is not yet available in the public site package; the submission uses provisional_boundaries.geojson (official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough) for temporary generation, visualization, and intake self-check only.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics and spatial conclusions are provisional and must be recalculated after official polygons are obtained; the organizer data gap does not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setback), road redlines, land ownership, municipal utilities, heritage control lines, and engineering constraints are not present in the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: floor_area_ratio and all control indicators are marked unknown; spatial moves are conceptual suggestions only and cannot be used as statutory planning or approval basis.

assumptions.statement: Three key detailed-design areas (Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin Community, Dazhongsi) use provisional rough rectangles derived from the announcement's north-to-south order and approximate areas; no official key-area polygons are available.
assumptions.impact: Key-area detailed designs are directional; building massing, retain/renovate/demolish, and transport conclusions must be revisited after official key-area polygons and regulatory conditions are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Annual event system, developer community operation, scenario opening, branding, and international communication mechanisms are concept proposals for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: All activities, investment, policy, and operation arrangements are written as conceptual suggestions, not confirmed government decisions or implementation commitments.

assumptions.statement: The 8 global AI innovation ecosystem cases (Kendall Square, King's Cross, Station F, One-North, Nanshan, Pangyo, MaRS, Kalasatama) cite only publicly verifiable mechanisms; no investment amounts, output values, or enterprise lists are fabricated.
assumptions.impact: Case-derived transfer mechanisms are reference schemes; they do not constitute confirmed investment attraction or enterprise commitments.
